headline: Names a US Postal Service building in London, Ohio as the "London Fallen Veterans Memorial Post Office."
what_it_does: This law renames the post office at 25 South Oak Street in London, Ohio. The new name is the "London Fallen Veterans Memorial Post Office." It is a naming law only and does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2014.
